testcase.name: Purity: no clocks, randomness, threads, platform types or dependency on the M2 time package; no mutable statics (sections 1, 9)
Portability: no java.lang.Math transcendental, pow, hypot or fma calls; trigonometry goes through StrictMath (section 7, DM3-7)
Public API: the seven specified types are public; curves are records implementing Curve; every other source type is not public (section 2)
